title: Passive phonon spectra admit a model-specific one-resonator optimum
status_authority: Selected source bytes and producer-reported internal reviews are preserved. This integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority or practical advantage.
reported_status: The selected Ultra construction and continuation report a finite-temperature optimum for a scalar periodic harmonic backbone, followed by an attainable-spectrum family theorem. A root review reports an internal mathematical pass for the family theorem; device and priority claims remain open.
scientific_scope_status: Under fixed total cell mass and backbone spring, a positive lower bound on backbone mass, and ideal-contact one-dimensional scalar ballistic transport, the source reports a one-resonator realization minimizing the stated Bose-weighted conductance over its admitted finite passive internal networks. A later theorem reports a broader attainable-spectrum and inverse-design family. Finite connector/interface checks are separate model calculations.

proof_availability.classification_scope: The proof statements are limited to the declared scalar periodic ballistic model. Finite connector and thermal-port records are retained separately; no physical device or external audit is supplied.
